scope: A2 candidate_adapter.go/_test.go only after core native terminal and separate freeze; do not edit legacy nonce.go or ca.go

A1_global_L1.placement: after complete global installation prefix, before producer domain
A1_global_L1.semantics: stream complete global range including empty insertion gaps; only target installation count/version/hash/enabled decides L3, foreign material validity does not preempt historical read

API.name: Validator.PrepareCandidateAttempt(ctx, originalGrant, disabledConfig)
API.semantics: strict input/scope/config/context errors; physical errors captured closed for new-use after L3; check every original active+retained key, exact descriptor+actual32byte material, wipe bytes, preserve <=30s and original binding window; no invented grant/provider facts

API.name: PreparedCandidateNonce.DependencyDeadline()
API.result: owned optional original UTC6 ceiling deadline
API.semantics: nil physical failure is not unlimited validity; original authority must intersect successful original unrenewed limit into admission dependency deadline; historical branch ignores resource freshness without renewing it

API.name: PreparedCandidateNonce.LockReferences(ctx, BootstrapSQL)
API.semantics: only fresh-consume branch at L5; read already L1-locked GLOBAL config tuples; acquire GLOBAL retained raw nonce range using original shared cutoff and idx_sb_auth_nonce_retention order retain_until,id; stream no new raw-row cap; no physical reads here until stage decision

API.name: LockedCandidateNonce.Recheck(ctx, BootstrapReadSQL)
API.semantics: same original cutoff and held global prefix; no earlier-layer/gap discovery; compare original global config tuples plus sole expected disabled-v1 row; preserve full key identity/version and retained maximum/ProtectedUntil; all shared time samples remain monotonic and within original raw window

material_validation_stage.must_preserve: original late descriptor/material changed/missing refusal and lifecycle protection across every original key
alternatives: A1/D2 explicitly review bounded original local-file verification before fixed FinalGuard, under single attempt deadline, then no callbacks/files after guard.
Concrete independently authenticated original immutable-version/lifecycle and current revocation state proves same material guarantees using narrow locked SQL.
material_validation_stage.forbidden: No snapshot-only default acceptance, new approved boolean, fabricated material/provider proof, or silent weakening of legacy tests.
material_validation_stage.A1_decision: Root moves Bootstrap session.Recheck callbacks to the end of Work after writes/audits/snapshots but before write capability closure. Bounded original local-file validation plus shared SampleTime/plan/context occurs there. Then close capabilities, fixed SQL/snapshot-only Policy.Recheck, final time/context, sole A commit. Generic Policy.Recheck no-file contract remains intact.

counterexamples: Exact committed success + current g/RBAC/mapping, unrelated missing non-authorizing physical resource: history read permitted, no new epoch/ref/CAS/charge/probe. Same missing resource + no original success: deny before business writes.
Original grant/RBAC/mapping revoked or unauthenticated: both branches reject.
Foreign installation config has unknown nonce version or conflicting identity: first consume rejects; target-only filtering must not hide it.
Global retained ledger unknown version, NULL retention facts, maximum retention beyond original ProtectedUntil: reject.
Many duplicate config/nonce rows with one legitimate original version: stream without a false raw20000 cap, preserve UNION distinct semantics.
Retained-only old key missing/changed material, current descriptor changed/deleted after preparation: do not pass solely from memory snapshot.
Insertion into retained/global config gaps, changed old global tuple, unexpected extra new config or nonce ledger mutation: reject in final already-held range checks.
Final raw expiry equality, wait past deadline, intermediate SQL rollback, different context/transaction, ignored error/capability value copy: reject with no new authorization.

controlled_file_API.implementation: Keep only original deployment-owned grant path/SHA, registry dir, scope/config pins; direct concrete ReadBootstrapGrantFile and RegistrationFiles methods, opaque/private/redacted state, no new grant or arbitrary function safety flag
controlled_file_API.Prepare: reuse generic pinned snapshot preparation outside locks; require exact original deployment scope/config and g; physical non-RBAC failures deferred for L3 as agreed
controlled_file_API.Authorize: L2 current concrete grant/RBAC on both branches with shared SampleTime before/after; intersect identity with ORIGINAL raw offline window, never renewed from reread
controlled_file_API.new_use: current full9 concrete bytes/hash/size before original LockReferences and reservation/audit; resource authority remains mandatory
controlled_file_API.Recheck: Work-end: after all inner material callbacks, current concrete grant/RBAC for both branches and full9 for new use only, final shared SampleTime; then D closes capability and runs callback-free fixed FinalGuard

CA_API: CandidateCACheck.Recheck(ctx,BootstrapReadSQL) error -- only Work-end callback stage, preserve original bounded files() checks, no TLS/provider/clock callback/new locks
